## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Mòluó wáng jīng* (T517) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by [沮渠京聲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B2%AE%E6%B8%A0%E4%BA%AC%E8%81%B2) Jǔqú Jīngshēng. The protagonist *Mòluó wáng* 末羅王 may render Sanskrit *Malla-rāja* (king of the Malla clan, who hosted the Buddha's *parinirvāṇa* at Kuśinagara).

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna*-style narrative on a Mallaka king's encounter with the Buddha. Translation dated to Jǔqú Jīngshēng's productive period (455–464 CE).
